# Gene-Tree Environment Routing

This is a sidecar adapter: it selects where approved work can run, not what the biological analysis should claim.

1. Read the [canonical Skill](../../../skills/bio-gene-to-reference-tree/SKILL.md) and [workflow gates](../../../skills/bio-gene-to-reference-tree/references/workflow.md).
2. Follow [environment and software routing](../../../skills/bio-gene-to-reference-tree/references/environment-routing.md).
3. Open [tool routing](../../../skills/bio-gene-to-reference-tree/references/tool-routing.md) before a live lookup, remote submission, external executable, or database choice.
4. Return the capability snapshot, route decision, missing dependencies, and handoff boundary to the active scientific task.

Return the linked routing outputs to whichever scientific task is active.
